title: Workspace query, selection and result authority
summary: Wire UI Server owns query/scope/order/selection/result revisions. Renderers carry the exact workspace context back with semantic actions; they do not reconstruct or certify business query state locally.
invariants: Sort changes ordering and may preserve selection when semantic membership is unchanged.
Scope-changing filters invalidate stale selection by default.
Selected identities are semantic IDs independent of the currently materialised window.
Commands bind to the exact query, scope, order, selection and result revisions projected by the server.
A changed authoritative business result invalidates an old command even when the same rows remain selected.
Renderer-local selection is not server workspace-selection truth.
Paging/windowing does not redefine membership or semantic row identity.

provenance.claim: Server v0.17 result revision plus v0.16 query/selection and v0.15 collection-window authority.
